scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace widthwatch && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.scan:demo: npm run build --workspace widthwatch && node packages/widthwatch/dist/cli.js https://example.com --output reports/example.html
scripts.pack:smoke: npm run build --workspace widthwatch && node scripts/smoke-packed.mjs
scripts.proof:generate: npm run build --workspace widthwatch && npm run build --workspace @widthwatch/web && node scripts/generate-proof.mjs
